payload: Read the following part request and formal dimension contract. Part request: 'Make an L-shaped bracket with a base 60 mm long, 40 mm wide, and 6 mm thick. The vertical arm is 40 mm tall, 40 mm wide, and 6 mm thick. Include two 5 mm diameter holes in the base, centered 10 mm from the short edges and 10 mm from the long edges.' Formal dimension contract: 'base_length = 60 mm; base_width = 40 mm; base_thickness = 6 mm; arm_height = 40 mm; arm_width = 40 mm; arm_thickness = 6 mm; hole_diameter = 5 mm; hole_center_offset_from_short_edge = 10 mm; hole_center_offset_from_long_edge = 10 mm; hole_count = 2.' Bind the contract to the build123d script you will create. State the formal claim you will verify.
